decisions: fight_params.py is a fifth module the stage-11 roster does not name, and without it neither arm on pipeline.py clears. Measured: the roster's four modules move 746 body lines out of 1646, leaving a 732-line residue (P4 ledger_inputs 26, P7 FightParams 336, P8 run_fight 297, plus the 91-line header) against a 500-line ceiling. The map's '~470 remainder' omits the header and under-counts run_fight. With FightParams moved the residue is 353 lines and every new module is under 500.

The same move is what makes the assignment check at all. _keystone_self_healing_events and _attach_engine_receipts both annotate params: 'FightParams', and the tool reads a quoted annotation as a real read, so with FightParams in the residue rune_sustain_events.py and fight_receipts.py are back-edges. Moving FightParams turns both into forward edges and keeps each roster module's def list exactly as the roster names it.

Cost, stated rather than hidden: fight_params.py lands at 11 internal imports and about six src/calculator readers, so it inherits a fan-out finding. The map declined this trade on the premise that the size arm cleared without it; the measurement above retires that premise. pipeline.py's own fan-out finding survives either way at 15 internal imports, so the counter moves from two findings on one module to one on each of two, and a reader gets a 353-line entry point.

Two shaves are the only route to a zero on fight_params.py's fan-out arm: champions.skill_orders (one call, get_ability_rank) reached through champions, and stats (one call, resolve_pre_combat_stats). Neither is free and both are out of this assignment's scope.
